name: media-review-panel
description: Side panel that shows what Claude reads while it analyzes paid media (Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn Ads): each query the panel recognizes, accounts, steps, data level, dates, chart numbers and the numbers of Claude's final answer checked against the account data, and a log of each call it logged. Read-only. Made by Tráfego Com Pedro.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows the language of your messages; en = English; pt = Brazilian Portuguese

theme.title: Panel theme
theme.description: auto follows the app's light or dark theme; light and dark force one

mascot.title: Mascot
mascot.description: on shows Bip, the robot, with short status messages; off hides it (you can also mute it in the panel)

autoOpen.title: Open the panel automatically
autoOpen.description: on opens the panel when Claude first reads paid media data in a review; off waits for /media-review

extraScripts.title: Your own data scripts
extraScripts.description: Names of scripts on this computer that read ad data, separated by commas (for example: my_report.py, fetch_ads.py). Saved only in your local settings, never in the mod's files. Scripts that print raw Google Ads or Meta data are recognized without this.
